task.description: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF-02 Step 1b) hard gate on REQ-163's decision artefact at lib/letflow/design/req163-wasm-abi-choice.md. This artefact chose 'core modules' over the component model, grounded in wasmex v0.15.1's published documentation (quoted, cited with URLs and access date 2026-08-28). Independently re-verify the cited evidence -- do not trust the artefact's own quotes at face value. Use WebFetch to re-check at least the key claims: hex.pm's current wasmex version, whether Wasmex.Components is genuinely documented as 'beta quality', and whether Wasmex.Wasi.WasiP2Options genuinely has no filesystem field. Also verify the artefact's placement decision (lib/letflow/design/ vs. a new docs/migration/decisions/ record) is reasonable given its own stated reasoning, and that all 7 real acceptance criteria are satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: Independently re-fetch hex.pm's wasmex package page (or hexdocs.pm) and confirm the version number and release date the artefact cites are accurate as of a fresh check -- note if the published version has changed since 2026-08-28 and whether that changes the artefact's conclusion.
Independently re-fetch Wasmex.Components' hexdocs page and confirm the 'beta quality' quote is accurate, not fabricated or taken out of context.

Independently re-fetch Wasmex.Wasi.WasiP2Options' hexdocs page and confirm it genuinely has no filesystem/preopen field, supporting the artefact's claim that neither mode offers a lighter-weight filesystem-denial escape hatch.
Confirm the artefact's Decision heading names exactly one choice with no 'either' fallback.

Confirm the WASM-02 four-export ABI restatement (section 3) is internally consistent and detailed enough for a hypothetical implementer to build against without further research -- check for any gap or ambiguity in the descriptor-pointer convention or the implicit alloc export requirement.

Confirm the REQ-167 import-denial surface (section 4) is a real, concrete WASI Preview 1 import name/signature, not an invented one -- spot check that path_open's cited 9-parameter signature is plausible for WASI Preview 1's real snapshot ABI.

Confirm the REQ-150/WASM-12 numeric mapping (section 5) is consistent with REQ-150's own cited rule -- read lib/letflow/design/req150-lua-number-marshalling.md section 2 directly to verify no contradiction.
Confirm no mix.exs or lib/letflow/engine/ file was touched -- run git diff --stat yourself.
CRITICAL: the handoff's top-level status field (line 9) must be exactly PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/FAILED/ESCALATED/CANCELLED when you finish -- run mix letflow.lint_handoffs before finishing.
